notes.title: The release of the City Car Driving 2.0 has been moved to May 2025
notes.notes:
We are facing a number of development challenges for us to overcome before release. We will be using this delay time to fix the discovered bugs and introduce the required changes covered in details below together with the game road map and our news.

We appreciate your understanding and patience and assure you that we on the CCD2 team are making our best efforts to deliver a game that will meet our standards and your expectations.

[h1][b]MAIN REASONS FOR DELAYED RELEASE[/b][/h1]

[b]Road Traffic.[/b]

Developing realistic road traffic is one of our key challenges we have been working on hard for many months. Our ambitious goal for City Car Driving 2 is to outmatch road traffic from Part 1 of the game by unleashing full power of Unreal Engine.

For switching to the new engine, we have been rewriting road traffic almost from scratch. Legacy code developed for another technology would not function correctly on the new engine. This ambitious and complex challenge requires continuous rework and fixes. We do not stop our development works for a second. This delay will give us much needed time to achieve best functionality possible at the current stage.

[b]Fine-tuning Gameplay.[/b]

This winter, we have kicked-off a large-scale remodeling of the gameplay affecting many of its aspects. Currently, we are working or balancing and aligning all game mechanics so that you could enjoy a comprehensive game experience right from early access. We are testing the game on an ongoing basis to detect and fix bugs. In this extra time, we will be able to work more thoroughly on critical areas of the game. 

Our main goal remains unchanged: to deliver City Car Driving 2.0 with entertaining gameplay, well-planned physics, and best road traffic simulation supporting Traffic Rules.

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2327720/view/4374769594832404746]The full news can be found on the City Car Driving 2.0 page[/url][/b]

notes.title: The release of the City Car Driving 2.0 has been moved to September 2024
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26638552/50bc180f6df7d9578a2da19e4e413ea412de9814.png[/img]

It is already obvious to us that we have developed the basic gaming environment, but did not have time to fill it with content. At the moment, we are adding various missions and challenges so that, even in early access, the game differs from the first CCD. And so that, due to changes in the game formula, it does not feel like a “step back.” Also, mechanics related to the transport ecosystem require polishing. They are all connected with the economy, and we want to make them simple but good. They are fully functional, however, the economic factor in the game requires tying everything into a single fabric.

notes.title: December update
notes.notes:
Meet the latest City Car Driving update in 2019! 🔥

In this update, we focused on fixing logical mistakes in the traffic rules interpretation, namely:

➜ Fixed the unfair fine “Stopped not at the edge of the roadway” that was issued in the "City test" sometimes.

➜ Removed the fine for turning right a red light for the Canadian locale - yes, yes, the rules in Canada are so interesting.

➜ Fixed determination of the driving priority when the roadway is narrowing, indicated by the sign #5.15.5 - “End of lane”.

➜ Sorted out the anomalous zone at the crossing of Monash and Kensington streets - nothing threats your mental balance there anymore.

➜ Also corrected the camera in the SUV's interior, because earlier it worked a bit weird sometimes.

👉🏻 You can download the updated version in Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/493490

notes.title: City Car Driving has been updated to version 1.5.9!
notes.notes:
It's time for the big Autumn update of City Car Driving! The simulator has been updated to version 1.5.9 🔥

Let's take a look what we've prepared for you in this release:

➤ New feature - a service station.

In this new version we added a new feature - a car repair without restarting your driving session, right during the driving in the free driving mode.

In case of a malfunction, you can either drive to the service station by yourself or "teleport" there on a tow truck.

In case of a major malfunction (for example, steering or braking system failure, etc.) you must visit a service station in order to repair your vehicle, just like in a real life.

For perfoming transportation missions on a faulty vehicle, the user gets lower rating.

Also we changed the emergency situations algorithm. Now they appear less often.

➤ Improved the big navigator screen.

Now you can: 

Scroll the map with the left mouse button within its display area.

Double-click the left mouse button to set a destination point on the map in order to pave the route to it.

New various objects are marked on the map now - in addition to fuel stations: large car parkings, hypermarkets, service stations, monuments.

And some temporary marks of the destination and intermediate points of the route: the key point of passenger and cargo transportation and the destination point of a randomly generated or manually set route.

➤ Changing the weather, time of day or traffic density right during the driving.

Now you can select the time of day, weather conditions, traffic density and behavior without restarting the virtual world.

➤ New city exam.

A new generated route in the new city will be issued to the user in the basic mode of the career instead of the old one.

The old route was always the same, but the new one is randomly generated each time and has a lot of options for training.

For Australian profile the old version of the city exam is kept.

➤ Added Canadian localization: new emergency vehicles, road signs, license plates, fines, “special” right turn on red.

➤ Added a new light commercial vehicle with automatic transmission in 2 versions: freight and freight-passenger, with the option of driving with a trailer.

➤ Added an automatic transmission for the SUV.

➤ Expanded the choice of right-hand drive cars by adding cars that previously had only left-hand drive versions.

➤ Added an option to couple and uncouple a trailer.

➤ Now all the monuments are in their permanent places, regardless of the selected city decoration.

➤ Now you can select the language directly in the simulator itself, but not only in the Steam client.

➤ Added Kazakh localization, that earlier was available only in the website version of the simulator.

➤ Made the virtual world more realistic.

➤ Optimized graphics and performance.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pjVleGFi2fw

notes.title: June update!

Dear friends, we've brought for you the first Summer update in Steam! 👇🏻

notes.title: May update!
notes.notes:

Let's take a look at the most interesting changes in version 1.5.8.1:

➜ The “City test” mission was aligned with the rules - now its time limit is 30 minutes.

➜ Fixed the mission "A new exam" - added monitoring of whether low beam headlights are on.

➜ If you are training your driving skills to drive on US roads, then it might interest you to know that now the braking distance is shown in miles and the initial speed is shown before braking.

notes.title: City Car Driving has been updated to version 1.5.8
notes.notes:
April is just the time to try something new and exciting! For example, the new City Car Driving 1.5.8. 🔥

Let’s start with the most important new features: 

➤ Training in goods transportation with a passenger car.

We have added new exercises for a passenger car with a trailer. Now you can raise your trailer driving skills before getting it. ːsteamhappyː

➤ Goods transportation in the game mode.

If you feel like you’ve mastered trailers already, you can try yourself in real transportation!

Using an app on the game phone (VR tablet), you can choose and start completing goods transportation orders. 

A loader will be waiting for you at the loading area to give you the goods, and the route will guide you to the unloading point. 

Your progress depends on how well you transport goods. As you level up, you will be entrusted with fragile goods, or even with unloading one batch in two different places. 

➤ Trailer for the player.

You can not only use the trailer training function to train in the career mode, but also use the trailer in the free driving mode. 

You can attach the trailer to any stock or modded car (if the modder adapted it). Only the player has a trailer. AI traffic cars and pedestrians can see it and do not pass through it. 

Be careful: you can easily cause an accident or run someone over with your trailer. 

➤ Spring on the road.

You can now choose spring for your ride: the simulator finally offers all four seasons. Try it: it’s truly beautiful. ːsteamhappyː

➤ Cosmonautics Day decorations

If you wanted to become an astronaut when you were young, just like our developers did, this one’s for you. 

As they say, “Every driver carries a space helmet in their trunk!” 🚀

〰 And here are also some smaller yet quite pleasant updates 〰 

● New achievements for transportation experts.
● License plate lighting added (for trailers too!).
● Some small but important interface fixes.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5eN-gNfec7E

notes.title: City Car Driving has been updated to version 1.5.7
notes.notes:
Dear friends, we have prepared for you a big update of our car simulator! 

City Car Driving has been updated to version 1.5.7 – let's see what cool stuff awaits you in this version.

Let's start from the most exciting two features that you had long requested and awaited:

➤ Steam achievements 

The career walkthrough has become even more exciting. Dozens of rewards for completing the challenges. From the easiest ones, which will work themselves out, to those where you’ll have to make up your mind and do a lot of driving around the game world. Be the first to collect them all!

➤ Passenger transportation

For those who feels lonely in a car, we added the passenger transportation feature – complete the missions and get bonuses. The more passengers are satisfied, the more fuel you'll get available on your fuel card!

~ And some smaller, but very good updates ~

● Water splashes flies off from under the car wheels in rainy and wet weather.
● Reflections in the rearview mirrors react to the head position when using VR, also added easier mirror adjustment.
● Traffic cars that leaving parking lots became more noticeable to allow you get more interesting situations on the road.
● Optimized the game loading and fixed many minor bugs.

You can download the latest version on Steam now or a bit later on our official website.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9kxCgfwzF_4

notes.title: Version 1.5.7 beta test!
notes.notes:
Do you want to make your favorite driving simulator better? Or maybe you like searching for bugs, or even bugs usually find you? :)

Join our beta testing team of version 1.5.7!

➤ All you need to do to take a part in the beta test is to fill out this form: https://vk.cc/8CNPD7

After the beta test start, you will get access to a private Steam group, where you'll find all the information related to the beta test, and where you can leave your feedback on the beta version.

The beta version will be available only in Russian and English.

Accepting applications stops on November 6th.

P.S. If you joined our beta testing group earlier, you do not need to fill out the questionnaire again - you are in the team already!

notes.title: June update!

It's time for good news - we've updated City Car Driving to version 1.5.6.2!

In this version:

➜ Now AI cars in left-handed traffic profile can park masterfully, in the same way as they do it in right-handed profile.

And what would you like to change or add to City Car Driving? Maybe it's your idea that we will implement in the next version. ;)

P.S. Yes, we know many would like to play online with friends. But no. Let's think together how to make City Car Driving the best car simulator without multiplayer.

notes.title: April update!
notes.notes:
We proud to present the City Car Driving update to version 1.5.6. In this version we paid more attention to the gameplay and made the simulator more realistic.

Implemented one of the most popular requests: a simulation of fuel consumption in the free driving mode. Gas stations are usable now. Fuel consumption level depends on the style of driving. The navigator automatically routes you to the nearest gas station when you have low fuel. And of course the fuel system can be turned off in the game settings.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26638552/2634052c034cace51c8cb9da23c4cfdb3377e7e4.png[/img]

Improved the career mode. Now in the first group of exercises you can select one of the default cars, which you'd like to drive. City test for EU and US profiles became easier, now the penalty for speeding is 7 kmph for the EU profile and 3 mph for the US profile.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26638552/f6c9221b102eb6d72951b55d608b3ca3334a31af.png[/img]

We continue to improve the traffic AI. For now we taught him to park and leave parking lots, but we also have plans of other new things to teach the AI. Also now you can see the traffic cars, which are more common for the selected traffic profile.

We looked at our country roads and realized that they really lack dust. Now when you drive on a dirt road, dust appears from under the wheels, as it should be.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26638552/698ee3ed59e4416a34249c5ec124183ec1f8249a.png[/img]

Between this and then we updated the pedestrian appearance and the interface of the weather selection menu in the free driving mode.

And of course we continue to fix bugs and optimize the simulator.
https://youtu.be/bKRQlmoB2rY

notes.title: Version 1.5.4 released!
notes.notes:
It's time for a new Spring release. We added new features, support of new devices and made other useful changes.

[b]In the new version you will see:[/b]
[list]
[*]In addition to the already available support for Oculus Rift VR headset and TrackIR head tracker, added native HTC Vive support. ReVive is not needed anymore!

[*]Reformed the controller's input system. Improved support for DirectX compatible wheels: Logitech G920 / G29 / G27, Defender Forsage Drift GT and others. As well the following devices are fully supported in the simulator now:

Gamepads:
- Xbox One / 360
- Sony Dualshock 4
- Thurstmaster Dual Trigger 3 in 1 v.2

Joysticks:
- Logitech Extreme 3D Pro
- Genius MaxFighter F-17

[*]The control settings menu is expanded. Now you can fine-tune your devices.

[*]Added new exercises in the section "Driving School Student", which allow you to train U-turns in a limited space and your steering skills.

[*]Added support of German traffic rules. Authentic road signs and traffic rules violation tracking for Germany, including a table of penalties (in statistics you can see how much your violations cost, moreover it is now available directly from the main menu).

[*]Added languages: Danish, Finnish.

[*]Improved support for third-party modifications from Steam Workshop.

[*]Fixed auto-update issue on Steam.
[/list]

[b]Attention! In connection with the changes, previously created records of driving sessions will not be played![/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VXA6qx6QIz0

notes.title: Autumn update!
notes.notes:
Well, the time has come for the next release this autumn!

And how can an autumn release be without a real autumn? We have added one more season! Now you can drive in summer, winter and autumn.

Also the virtual city has been prepared for the upcoming Christmas. You can plunge into the colorful atmosphere of celebration and miracles in just a couple of mouse clicks.

Oculus Rift CV1 owners can easily use their headsets and plunge into the reality of the virtual city streets. Also we started working closely on support for HTC Vive.

For mods fans - now you can easily upload custom cars in the Steam Workshop and install them in just one mouse click. And there is a hatchback added already as an example. So, we are waiting for your high-quality models!

P.S.: Auto update in Steam should start after some time. If you wish to get the update immediately - uninstall the game in Steam and then install again..

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KdvU1i7LClE
